mapper.insert: insert into user_token_quota (user_id, daily_limit, monthly_limit, total_limit) values (#{userId}, #{dailyLimit}, #{monthlyLimit}, #{totalLimit})
insert ignore into user_token_quota (user_id, daily_limit, monthly_limit) values (#{userId}, 100000, 3000000)
mapper.update: update user_token_quota set daily_used = 0, last_reset_daily = curdate()
mapper.select: select * from user_token_quota order by user_id
